wingman.baseUrl.description: Base URL of the Wingman backend (OpenAI-compatible API).

wingman.apiKey.description: API key for model discovery and chat requests to the Wingman backend. Run Wingman: Sync Models after changing it. Stored in plain settings, so keep the default for a local backend without authentication.

wingman.agentHost.autoStart.description: Start Wingman's AHP server and configure VS Code Chat automatically: for the first folder of a trusted local workspace, or one host for all projects in the Agents window. Requires wingman-agent and a VS Code window that supports AHP host settings.

wingman.agentHost.executable.description: Wingman executable path or launcher command, such as /bin/devtool wingman. When not explicitly set, reads ~/.wingman/path, then falls back to wingman on PATH. Quote paths or arguments containing spaces in launcher commands. Appends server --no-browser automatically. Uses the agent's own provider configuration.

scripts.build: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.mjs --production
